decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the rear extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The window in the side wall of the approved front extension shall contain obscure glazing and be permanently maintained as such.

Condition : 7 - The shed at the back of the rear garden shall be demolished and all resultant debris removed from the site prior to the construction of the approved rear extension.  The demolished shed shall not be reinstated.
Condition : 8 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
description: Erection of a single storey front extension, single storey rear extension, and alterations to convert garage into habitable room.
